 EPFO holds ‘Nidhi Aapke Nikat’ camp in Almora
 By Garhwal Post - October 29, 2026 123 0 
 SHARE 
 Facebook 
 Twitter 
 Garhwal Post Bureau 
 Almora, 27 Oct: The Employees’ Provident Fund Organisation (EPFO) organized a ‘Nidhi Aapke Nikat’ camp at KMVN, Mohan, in Almora district. During the camp, Regional Provident Fund Commissioner-II Akash Verma, along with Regional Enforcement Officers Aditya Joshi and Shailesh Roy, listened to the grievances and complaints of representatives from various establishments and took necessary action for their resolution.
On this occasion, Akash Verma provided detailed information to the attending representatives about various schemes and campaigns operated by EPFO. He specifically highlighted the objectives, benefits, and key provisions of the Pradhan Mantri Viksit Bharat Rozgar Yojana, Vishwas Yojana, and the Employee Enrolment Campaign.
Verma encouraged representatives of the establishments to avail the benefits of these schemes, ensure the rightful enrolment of eligible employees, and comply with social security-related provisions.
During the camp, employees and employers got the opportunity to gather information on provident fund, pension, and other social security matters, as well as interact directly with officials to resolve their issues.
The ‘Nidhi Aapke Nikat’ camp is an important initiative aimed at making EPFO services more accessible, enhancing awareness among employees and employers, and facilitating smooth grievance redressal. The participating employees and employers gathered information regarding various schemes and services.
